classification.difficultyReason: Identify exterior angles and combine their sum with supplementary angles and a right angle.

content.prompt: Determine the sizes of the labelled angles in these diagrams.

spec.description: Unshaded triangle with extended diagonal, vertical side and base; three exterior-angle arcs.
spec.mathematics: Exterior angles 128°, 92° and a sum to 360°. Diagram proportions reproduce the source schematically; no lengths are asserted.
spec.answerVisibility: Only 128°, 92° and unknown a are visible.

spec.description: Unshaded irregular pentagon with five side extensions, exterior-angle arcs and the adjacent interior angle c at the upper-right vertex.
spec.mathematics: Exterior angles are 82°, b, 110°, 77° and 38° in cyclic order. At the upper-right vertex b+c=180°. Coordinates represent source proportions, without asserted lengths.
spec.answerVisibility: Given angles and unknown b and c only.

spec.description: Unshaded quadrilateral with a coordinate-derived lower-left right-angle square, three labelled exterior-angle arcs and adjacent interior angle e.
spec.mathematics: The lower-left sides are perpendicular. Exterior angles are d, 76°, 122° and 90°; d+e=180°. No lengths are asserted.
spec.answerVisibility: Only 76°, 122°, the right-angle marker and unknown d and e are visible.

answer.worked:
The exterior angle at the right-angle vertex is $90^{\circ}$.
$$\begin{aligned}d&=360^{\circ}-76^{\circ}-122^{\circ}-90^{\circ}\\&=72^{\circ}\\e&=180^{\circ}-72^{\circ}\\&=108^{\circ}\end{aligned}$$
